answer_1.quote: ABEX moves beyond simple text-editing or rephrasing and generates diverse augmentations by introducing a new context. Augmentations by ABEX are also more coherent and label-consistent.
answer_1.outputs: Synthetic text augmentations (expanded sentences) generated from abstract descriptions

answer_2.quote: Table compares the generation quality of ABEX with all our baselines ... on the measures of perplexity, diversity (average percentage of new tokens introduced in R augmentations relative to the total tokens in the original document) and length diversity.

answer_4.quote: We define Coherence as the quality of the generated augmentation to be linguistically coherent. We define Label Consistency as the quality of the generated augmentation to maintain the same label... For all 3 criteria, we provide a red cross if it doesn't meet them and a green tick if it does.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate each generated augmentation on Coherence, Label Consistency, and Context Diversity, marking whether each criterion is satisfied.
